draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.21, the 82nd-best grade among 257 2026 draftees and 9th of 27 at CB. He lasted until pick 124, well after his grade rank (82nd): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Andru Phillips. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 4 passes defended in 2025, 23rd of 27 CBs in his class with stats.
